notes.title: Patch#1
notes.content:
Patch#1 02.07.24 notes:

Hey!
Welcome to the first patch for CosmoPirates!

We've introduced a new feature many of you asked for, and there are 3 new decks (so 4 in total) to choose from when starting the game.
To make things a bit more challenging you would need to unlock those new decks by defeating bosses on the first map.
(which shouldn't be a problem for such a daring space captain like you, right?)

We've also made several bugfixes:
- fixed JP2's enemy deck.
- fixed a bug when winning the fight with the dead captain, the game froze on the reward screen.
- fixed a bug when opening item inventory while choosing cards for discard was crashing the game.
- cards in the deck viewer are now shown without current modifications from active perks while in space fight.
- fixed a bug when it was impossible to exit the ship shop with an empty (bought) slot after revisiting.
Share your thoughts about the new decks and keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: CosmoPirates Updates and Participation in the Steam Deckbuilders Fest!
notes.content:
Ahoy, Bounty Hunters!


We are excited to announce that CosmoPirates has participated in this year's Steam Deckbuilders Fest! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44364199/97e3247edaed6bcfc91d3650e11af9b5412ea469.jpg[/img]

To celebrate this occasion, we have prepared a new trial version of CosmoPirates for everyone to enjoy.

Here are the updates we've made:

[list]
[*] [b]Sound Effects Update:[/b] Implemented new sound effects for nanobots, physical attacks, and power loss.
[*] [b]Tutorial Improvements:[/b] Added tutorial animations for better guidance.
[*] [b]New Animations:[/b] Introduced a new animation for nuke launches.
[*] [b]Enhanced Character Interaction:[/b] Added blood animation when crew members are hit.
[*] [b]Operational Optimization:[/b] Players can now select cards using the left and right arrow keys, confirm selections with the spacebar, and end their turns using the end key.
[*] [b]Volume Adjustment Feature:[/b] Added continuous volume adjustment functionality.
[*] [b]New Game Content:[/b] Added new planets on the map.
[*] [b]New Hints:[/b] Added new BOSS indicators.
[*] [b]Interface Improvements:[/b] Increased the size of the "Cards to discard" message for better visibility.
[*] [b]Rewards Screen Improvement:[/b] Enabled rollover functionality on cards in the prize screen.
[*] [b]Game Balance Adjustment:[/b] The nuke now also deals damage to your own crew.
[*] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Fixed the bug causing irregularities in the value of applied damage, issues with the ship shop, and the UI issue related to an excess number of cards.
[/list]

We look forward to you experiencing these updates and hope they bring you an even more immersive and thrilling gaming experience.

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. We will earnestly listen to all comments, suggestions, and feedback to guide our development and continuously optimize the game, ensuring progress towards the official release. Welcome to join our Discord channel, to stay up-to-date with the latest news!

notes.title: CosmoPirates Development Diary #1
notes.content:
[h1]Captain's log, stardate 231027! [/h1]
Welcome to the first entry in our CosmoPirates development diary. We're excited to share our journey with you as we continue to create an epic, hilarious, intergalactic deckbuilder. CosmoPirates is a game that we've poured our hearts and souls into, and we can't wait to bring it to life.

[h1]The Team[/h1]
Before we dive into the nitty-gritty, let's introduce ourselves. We are a small but passionate team of two developers – Karol and Robert. With a shared love for science fiction, space exploration, and gaming, we set out on this cosmic journey to create a game that captures the essence of adventure and excitement.

[h1]The Demo[/h1]
The demo is the first glimpse you'll get into the world of CosmoPirates. It will feature a slice of the gameplay, allowing you to get a taste of what's to come in the full game. We're striving to make the demo as polished and as engaging as possible. 
So far, we've completed the core gameplay mechanics, including card-based battles and map exploration. Karol has been hard at work creating an interesting, procedurally generated star segment for you to explore with every run. We can't wait to share the demo with you and start gathering your feedback!

[h1]Localization Efforts[/h1]
We hope that our game has the potential to resonate with a global audience, and that's why we're putting great effort into localization. 
Robert has been working on making the game easy to translate into multiple languages, ensuring that players from different corners of the world can fully enjoy the CosmoPirates experience. We don't really have a huge budget for localization, so we would need to carefully choose what languages to support in the first place. 

[h1]Future Features - The Crew[/h1]
From the very beginning, we envisioned CosmoPirates as a game that would not only take you on a thrilling journey across the stars but also allow you to meet a variety of characters along the way, and recruit some of them to your crew. We believe that in games (as in life) teamwork is the key, where each member brings their unique set of skills and perks to the table. We wanted players to forge deep connections with their crewmates and make choices that impact their journey through the cosmos.

Creating a diverse cast of crew members has been a labor of love. We've designed each character with their own backstory, personality, and skills. 
Some might be master engineers who can boost your ship's performance, while others could be cunning cutthroats, eager for a fight for a handful of credits. 
As you recruit different crew members, you'll discover their individual stories and quirks, making your crew feel alive and relatable.

Meet Istvan - one of the characters you might encounter during your journey. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44364199/2da2e0f60e367a91d45f3510d3c3a59dbebc4b77.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates, and remember, the universe is vast, but it's about to get a whole lot more exciting with CosmoPirates on the horizon!
